description:
Track your baby's feedings, diapers and weight, privately and offline
Baby Monito helps you follow your newborn's daily life: feedings, diapers, weight, daily care and medication.

Everything stays on your phone: no internet access, no account, no ads, no tracking.

• Feeding timer that keeps running with the screen off
• Weight curve alongside the WHO growth standards
• Daily care reminder
• Encrypted backup to move to a new phone
• In English and French — help translate it!

Permissions: notifications (reminder and feeding timer), exact alarms (reminder on time) and start at boot (keep the reminder after a restart). The "media playback" service only shows the feeding timer controls on the lock screen: nothing is played or recorded.
